# Native overhaul design recovery

Recovered enough planning detail to resume after the parent dispositions feedback/panel runtime. No repository or historical records were edited, no child tasks were spawned, and no build/test/package/install/download/device/app/browser/media lane ran. All writes are inside this design-recovery directory.

- [PLAN.md](PLAN.md): complete original WP1-WP11 package definitions, dependency/ownership map, current continuation annotation, performance and release boundaries.
- [icon-implementation-contract.md](icon-implementation-contract.md): accepted finite selection, converter, lazy native/gallery delivery, raster/export/lifecycle contract and missing-input gates.
- [RECONCILE.md](RECONCILE.md), [design-inventory.md](design-inventory.md), [selection table](icon-selection.md) and [selection JSON](icon-selection.reconstructed.json).
- [Sources with exact T3 item IDs](sources-index.md), [extraction provenance](reconstruction-provenance.json), [file hashes](file-hashes.json), [293-path before/after preservation](source-preservation.json).

## Current resumption boundary

WP0 and bounded hosting/tokens are implemented. R1/L1/F1/L2 source repairs are preserved. Fresh L2 build handoff and 17e/iOS 27.0 runtime report are current parent-owned evidence; portrait keyboard/feedback/reset/panels passed within their stated scopes. Filled compact-height/dark keyboard, Duo iOS 27.1 behavior, other matrix limitations and broader WP1/release gates remain open. The validation doc initially lagged the newer fallback report. This lane neither decides acceptance nor repeats runtime.

The next implementation does not need a new icon-design selection: Bluetooth is already corrected to canonical `bluetooth`, only Back/Send mirror, and the parent accepted finite fills/contexts. It does need a parent runtime/source disposition and durable missing-input/reference recovery. No temporary absolute paths, implicit reacquisition, substituted family, blanket fill expansion, or fake native-rendering claim should enter the implementation.

Remaining later-design decisions are concrete: SDK embed transport/auth/lifecycle; report receiver/privacy/retention/moderation; scheduling/public lookup/providers/calendar callbacks; personal-key/approval binding/idempotency; custom effects/voice-agent capability; minimum OS, physical performance/media and signed release/distribution. These were not resolved by the old plan and are not fabricated now.

## Preservation and bounded search

All 293 enumerated source hashes match both before and after. The parent gate-source-before.json SHA remains **4305a990580e2ef8355fb7d13054d04682dfc352720db2bc49539bd1d10eaf81**, unchanged. These checks cover the named freeze, not every dirty file or lost historical artifact. Source snapshots, local-context records and all output hashes are supplied.

Read only the named parent/five child timelines, decisive archived file bodies/patches, current validation/build/fallback reports, planned source-path inventory and exact saved workflow files. No unrelated threads, credential/config stores, or external network assets were searched. The surviving workflow has null plan/revision results despite its completion label; no workflow was restarted. Archived shell/Python text was parsed as data and never executed. Reconstruction scripts perform only local document extraction, structural counting and hashing.

The useful stopping point is reached: original package/dependency/decision structure and exact selected icon state mapping are recovered; missing full later-spec bodies and payload/provenance files remain explicit, bounded gaps. Parent owns live docs, acceptance and every implementation/build/runtime lane.
